title: CliRepairEvent
description: One append-only row in <workspace>/logs/cli-repairs.jsonl. Rows capture a local Windows Claude or Codex missing-shim/package-present repair attempt and its terminal outcome.

attemptId.description: Stable id shared by the attempting and terminal rows.

attemptedAt.description: UTC time when the hourly repair budget was consumed.

completedAt.description: UTC completion time; null on the attempting row.

cliType.description: Local CLI whose Windows shim disappeared.

packageName.description: Already-present npm package reinstalled by the repair.

versionBefore.description: Version read from package.json before reinstall.

versionAfter.description: Version returned by the repaired CLI, falling back to package.json.

missingShims.description: Missing global shim filenames observed before repair.

npmActivityBefore.description: Recent npm debug-log evidence captured before reinstall.

npmActivityAfter.description: Recent npm debug-log evidence captured after reinstall.

npmExitCode.description: npm process exit code when available.

npmStandardOutput.description: Bounded and credential-redacted npm stdout tail.

npmStandardError.description: Bounded and credential-redacted npm stderr tail.

error.description: Failure detail on a failed terminal row.

fileName.description: npm debug-log filename without its host directory.

sizeBytes.description: Debug-log size used to correlate installer activity.

relevantLines.description: Bounded credential-redacted command, install, update, package, or postinstall lines.
